description: Plan fixing a bug in `paginate()` in `src/api/paginate.ts`: page 2 repeats the last item of page 1, because the offset is computed as `(page - 1) * size - 1`. The file starts with the comment `// TODO: switch to cursor pagination, offsets are slow on large tables`. `paginate()` is called from `src/api/users.ts` and `src/api/orders.ts`, and its tests are in `src/api/__tests__/paginate.test.ts`. Available commands (from package.json scripts): `bun test`.

expected_outcome.description: The plan fixes the offset calculation and keeps the cursor-pagination TODO out of scope: no task switches to cursor pagination or changes how `src/api/users.ts` and `src/api/orders.ts` call `paginate()`.
